step: S3: the macOS app's scalable window
change: NTSDMacPlatform OriginalMacWindowHost: a scalable game window by default — the game's client geometry is held from creation (WindowLease.held, the mechanism the native full screen uses; set on the lease because the backend registers it after windowCreated), then the window becomes resizable with contentAspectRatio 794:550 and a half-size minimum and opens at the largest whole multiple ≥2 within 85% of the visible screen, else the fraction that fits (down to 0.5×); the size the window had when the game destroyed it (Alt+Enter's recreation) is the next one's, clamped to the screen. The picture is the view layer's contents scaled by the compositor with nearest filtering (no window-sized backing store); draw(_:) still renders view captures. Clicks map back through the aspect-kept picture (the held client before the first present); GetMessagePos under any held geometry is the held client's desktop origin plus the mapped point. The green button's full screen only scales; the hold is never released. NTSDApp: --original-window or the NTSDOriginalWindow default keep the original fixed window; scripted (--script) runs keep it too unless --scalable-window, so their captures stay the AppKit view renders. The game's Alt+Enter is unchanged.

review: Round 1 (independent, read-only): OK, low only — GetMessagePos inconsistent with the held geometry (fixed: mapped), clicks before the first present (fixed: held client size), the remembered size not clamped and missing zoom/tiling (fixed: clamped, recorded at DestroyWindow), small screens (fixed: down to 0.5×), the silent fallback (fixed: a stderr line), option docs (S6), test formatting (fixed). Round 2: OK — all round-1 items fixed; the layer path keeps sRGB colour matching, aspect-fit placement equal to the click mapping, main-thread presents and draw-based captures; low: the remembered-size test assumed room for 1.5× (fixed: 0.9×, suite rerun); recorded, not changed: in the game's own Alt+Enter popup MSG.pt stays physical while clicks map (pre-existing, outside S3), updateLayer resets constant layer properties each frame (negligible), and heldDesktopPoint extrapolates outside the window (Windows clamps GetMessagePos to the screen).
boundaries: Moving a scalable window off-screen or to another display no longer reaches the fixed window's 'screen changed'/geometry stops (the game keeps its creation geometry): recorded as a difference from the fixed window
Scales between 1 and 2 (and full screen) give uneven nearest pixels — the card's open question
A real hand click and a real green-button press remain hand checks (the user)
GetMessagePos for a cursor outside the scalable window is extrapolated (negative or off-screen values possible; Windows keeps it on the screen)
